0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Philadelphia 76ers visit the New York Knicks, and Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles. The 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, and the 76ers lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 144-114 defeat in Philadelphia on May 10. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win.
